dct_description_sm: Data from the prior year of monitoring (2021–2022) at LU2 and LU3 can be found at Data for Oil Sands Monitoring - Terrestrial Mammals - 2021–2022 https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/AIIA9G

Data on boreal mammal communities from Alberta, Canada, conducted for the joint Federal-Provincial Oil Sands Monitoring program (Terrestrial Biological Monitoring group) from 2022–2023. These data are from four different Landscape Units (LU1, LU13, LU15, and LU21). The data describes the sampling locations of remote infrared camera arrays, the locations of those arrays, the mammal data collected from the cameras, and the landscapes surrounding those arrays.
